insight.title: Earth's Water Is Older Than The Sun
insight.subtitle: Up to half of the water on our planet was formed in interstellar space before our star was even born.
insight.notificationHook: Our water is older than the sun

sections.text: Every drop of water in Earth's oceans, rivers, and clouds has a cosmic history. Recent astronomical models show that much of our water existed as ice floating in the freezing cold of interstellar space.

This means interstellar ice clouds survived the violent birth of our solar system. When the Sun finally ignited, this ancient water was already waiting in the dust cloud that would eventually form Earth.
The liquid filling the planet's oceans drifted through the dark, cold void of space for billions of years, predating the very star that now keeps it from freezing solid.
The Earth's oceans were brewed in the dark before the Sun.
